description: This script provides functionality for categorizing software commits, optionally leveraging a classifier model. It defines a Categorizer class with methods for processing commits, generating features, handling potential reverts, and interacting with the user for categorization decisions. The script is intended to be run as a command-line tool to facilitate commit management in a version control context.

classes.name: Categorizer
classes.description: A class responsible for categorizing commits, optionally using a machine learning classifier, and interacting with the user for categorization decisions.

methods.name: __init__(self, path, category="Uncategorized", use_classifier: bool = False)
methods.description: Initializes the Categorizer with the path to commits, optional category filter, and whether to use a classifier. Sets up the classifier if enabled.

methods.name: categorize(self)
methods.description: Processes the filtered commits, handling the categorization workflow for each.

methods.name: features(self, commit)
methods.description: Retrieves stored features for a specific commit.

methods.name: potential_reverts_of(self, commit, commits)
methods.description: Identifies potential revert commits related to a given commit based on titles and labels.

methods.name: handle_commit(self, commit, i, total, commits)
methods.description: Handles the interactive process for categorizing a single commit, including feature extraction, classifier prediction, and user input.

methods.name: update_commit(self, commit, category, topic)
methods.description: Updates the commit's category and topic, then saves the changes.

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.pattern: /^    def __init__(self, path, category="Uncategorized", use_classifier: bool = False):$/

ctags.name: handle_commit
ctags.pattern: /^    def handle_commit(self, commit, i, total, commits):$/
